relationships.subject: Arizona bark scorpion venom proteins
relationships.evidence_quote: Arizona bark scorpion (Centruroides sculpturatus) venom proteins inhibit Nav1.8 and block pain in grasshopper mice

relationships.subject: Arizona bark scorpion venom proteins
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that proteins may function as gating modifiers as opposed to pore blockers

key_findings: Four novel Arizona bark scorpion venom proteins from Nav1.8-inhibiting subfractions were identified.
Inhibition is voltage-dependent, suggesting gating modification.
